physicalNotes: No radius or mass of 3C 273 is recorded here: its package frames it at 112,980 pc (object.json worldFrame.bodyRadiusM), half the short side of its picture at its distance, a presentation value.

sources.position: Gaia Collaboration (2023), Gaia Data Release 3, A&A 674, A1; position as SIMBAD records it (https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202243940); SIMBAD 3C 273: RA 187.27791594049°, Dec 2.05238823055°, coordinate reference 2020yCat.1350....0G (Gaia EDR3)
sources.distance: Comoving distance of the redshift z = 0.15756751 (Koss et al. (2022), BASS XXII: The BASS DR2 AGN Catalog and Data, ApJS 261, 2; redshift as SIMBAD records it) in the Planck 2018 cosmology: 671841545.221143 pc, from Astropy 8.0.1 Planck18.comoving_distance (Planck Collaboration 2020, A&A 641, A6, https://arxiv.org/abs/1807.06209). The project's convention for objects placed by redshift (packages/bake/cli/prepare-catalogue-points.mts).
sources.properMotion: Zero: the object is held at its published position; no motion across the sky is applied.
sources.radialVelocity: c z for the redshift z = 0.15756751: the redshift written as a velocity, not a motion through space. Koss et al. (2022), BASS XXII: The BASS DR2 AGN Catalog and Data, ApJS 261, 2; redshift as SIMBAD records it (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022ApJS..261....2K); SIMBAD 3C 273: redshift 0.15756751 ± 0.0005, reference 2022ApJS..261....2K.
